name: camphor (natural)
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with: insect bites minor cuts minor burns sunburn scrapes minor skin irritations rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, or poison sumac
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only. When using this produc t avoid contact with eyes If condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a doctor.
